answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat guard the velvet rope. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents; each must solve a puzzle in 60 seconds and hold a 10 POA bond. Like a juniper, honest standing grows slowly: two missed checks forfeit the bond and erase history. Faking 1,000 agents costs 10,000 POA in bonds plus 1,000 machines always on, while the nectar flows only to survivors. One honest agent pays one bond and keeps its share.
